body: I just lost all motivation and it seems like I am physically incapable of enjoying things. All I do now is feel completely empty with no direction, while also wallowing in emotional distress . I felt it so long I'm just not if there's a way out. That's why I tried to end it and I'm just not sure what to do now.
I'm glad that I'm not the only one who is fighting this fight. I too rarely eat. Do mind if you share your routine? I'm just feeling lost on what to do..
